create_server_process_global_profile: create a _server_process_global_profile context manager to profile all RPC server threads with enabled, use_cuda, record_shapes options
run_rpc_server_profiling: run distributed RPC profiling across multiple workers using _server_process_global_profile as a context manager on remote workers
test_profiler_enter_exit: test the __enter__ and __exit__ methods of _server_process_global_profile to enable and disable server-side process-global profiling
review_function_events_aggregation: review how __exit__ aggregates thread-local profiling events into function_events and process_global_function_events from all RPC threads
build_nested_rpc_profiling: build nested _server_process_global_profile context managers on remote workers to profile inner and outer RPC call hierarchies
